claim_text: The Democrats' 2028 presidential primary calendar makes South Carolina the leadoff state, voting Jan. 22, 2028.
quote: The primary lineup pushes Iowa from the traditional top spot and makes South Carolina the leadoff state, voting on Jan. 22, 2028, followed by Nevada on Feb. 1.
confidence_justification: News report at the source-type ceiling; the calendar is a party-adopted schedule and the same text is reported independently by a second outlet (e0f3d191e5f1).
